description: Drag the browser using empty infobar space or the exposed top frame while preserving controls and page input.
preconditions: Use the exact recorded isolated Dev bundle with an acceptance-owned profile and --enable-automation
Hide the toolbar, keep the sidebar visible, and use a normal non-fullscreen window
steps: Drag empty space in the automation infobar and record the window position before and after
Verify the banner action and dismiss controls remain clickable; dismiss the banner
Drag the narrow exposed frame immediately above the webpage and record window movement
Click and select text inside the webpage; verify it does not drag the window
Repeat the top-frame check with both split orientations and each active pane
Enter fullscreen, verify page and banner controls remain usable, then exit fullscreen
Resize the window using its edge, then close and quit normally
observables: Empty banner padding and the exposed top frame move the normal window
Infobar text, action buttons, links, and dismiss controls remain client input
Neither webpage becomes a drag region when the lower stacked pane is active
Fullscreen and native window-edge resizing retain their existing behavior
Normal close and quit produce no new crash
